title: Bounded TLS Graceful-Close Investigation
binding_requirements: Q-B5B-09-OWNER-01 production remediation scope decision: Track B (TLS) DEFERRED, preserve current TLS behavior, no TLS disablement/downgrade/raw drain/experimental shutdown path authorized

Q-B5B-09-OWNER-01 carried-forward items: Windows real terminal TLS write interruption, real pending close_notify interruption, independent encrypted-byte-cap verification, native Linux TLS execution, integrated TLS resource and lifecycle controls
Q-B5B-05-OWNER-01 recommended next commission: Q-B5B-09-TLS bounded investigation of terminal TLS write backpressure and close-notification behavior
Q-B5B-09-TLS-GATE-01: platform budgets closed; two WSL2 terminal cases; Windows terminal and close-notification questions preserved; no automatic follow-up scheduled
investigation_questions: Q1: Can a genuine terminal TLS write backpressure be induced and interrupted on Windows, with bounded termination and cleanup?
Q2: Can a genuine TLS close_notify write be induced pending and interrupted? On which platforms?
Q3: Are the encrypted-byte limits (ciphertext input cap and decrypted discard cap) enforced independently, exactly, and detectably?
Q4: What does the current production TLS terminal path do under backpressure on Windows, and is its termination bounded and its cleanup complete?
Q5: Are any observed behaviors platform-specific socket semantics, TLS runtime behavior, harness limitations, or actual BoltSharp defects?

tracks.candidate: Reconstructed isolated candidate (23d58da + INV-02 prototype + INV-03 refinement + real-write observation + gate link-observation patches), the deferred TLS graceful-close design used as an investigation prototype only. No production code is modified.
tracks.production: The production assembly at the investigation HEAD, exercised without any code change; observed from the peer boundary and the listener diagnostics.

negative_controls.detection: cipher-cap drain exit with wire bytes above the declared 32768 bound fails the T5 oracle
pending terminal write settling after the 310 ms deadline-causality bound and the 500 ms total bound fails the T1 oracle

harness_limitation_controls.description: raw-socket mechanism probe: isolates the send-buffer shrink and pending-write semantics per platform, independent of Bolt and TLS layers

repeatability.repeatable_cell: three oracle-passing attempts with the same profile (one discovery plus two repeats)
stop_conditions: stop a cell at a qualifying result
stop the platform campaign on a demonstrated defect
at most four ordered profiles per cell, one for cap cells

wsl2.note: WSL2 is not native Linux; results are recorded separately and never claimed as native Linux

non_claims: no reopening of Q-B5B-04, Q-B5B-05, Q-B5B-09 plaintext, TS1 or Q-B3C-03 closures
no reopening of the accepted TLS-GATE-01 WSL2 terminal-write evidence
